written: 2026-10-30, before any per-team outlook (prompt v3) data existed
question: Does the AI news reader's read of each team's week (point impact, sentiment, context) improve on the production model's win probabilities, judged blind and prospectively?
features: src/nflpred/news_features.py game_features(home, away, cutoff = time of the full run, since = each team's previous game end); items count only if published AND seen by us before the cutoff, 7-day window

candidates.news_new_v1: production home margin + 1.0 x diff_impact_new (AI point estimates of news marked new), win prob = Phi(margin / sigma) with sigma implied by the production margin and probability for that game (13.5 if the margin is ~0)
candidates.news_sent_v1: production home margin + 1.0 x diff_sentiment + 0.5 x diff_ctx_net

evaluation: blind/prospective log, last probability logged before kickoff; scored only at blind/checkpoints.json dates; log loss and Brier vs production (paired SE) and vs the closing line
pass: log loss better than production with z >= 2 at the final checkpoint (2027-02-16) AND better at every checkpoint after the first; a candidate that passes becomes a model + news variant shown next to the model (never replaces it without a new pre-registration)
multiple_testing: 3 candidates: the z >= 2 bar is used per candidate; with 3 tries one false pass is ~7% likely, so a pass is a lead, not proof
also_logged: the same features for every game (history/news_game_features.jsonl) for later pre-registered tests (cover vs close)
